'''Armor Unit 14''' was a heavy [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] of [[Vulture Squad]], an armored military unit of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] present in the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]] in [[3627 BBY]].
